label: data-buffering
info:
Data Buffering Flow (FR4)

Buffers telemetry locally when cloud connectivity is lost and replays on reconnection.
Ensures zero data loss during network outages (NFR19).

Input: nexus/internal/cloud-connection-status (connection state from telemetry-publish flow)
Input: nexus/+/+/telemetry (normalized telemetry to buffer when disconnected)
Output: v1/devices/me/telemetry on ThingsBoard cloud (replayed buffered data)
Status: nexus/internal/buffer-status (buffer state for gateway-health flow)
Control: nexus/internal/telemetry-publish-control (pause/resume coordination)

Buffering strategy: Flow context array with Mosquitto QoS 1 delivery guarantees.
Reconnection sequence: detect reconnect → 2s delay → replay buffered → resume live.

name: Flow: data-buffering (FR4, NFR17, NFR19)
info:
Data Buffering Flow

Purpose: Buffer telemetry locally during cloud connectivity loss and replay on reconnection with zero data loss.

Inputs:
- nexus/internal/cloud-connection-status — connection state from telemetry-publish flow (Story 1.4)
- nexus/+/+/telemetry — normalized telemetry (same as telemetry-publish subscribes to)

Outputs:
- v1/devices/me/telemetry on ThingsBoard cloud — replayed buffered data
- nexus/internal/buffer-status — buffer state for gateway-health flow (Story 1.6)
- nexus/internal/telemetry-publish-control — pause/resume coordination
- nexus/internal/data-buffering-errors — error reporting

Reconnection Sequence (from Architecture):
1. Detect reconnect via cloud-connection-status topic
2. Debounce 3 seconds to confirm stable connection
3. Publish pause command
4. Wait 2 seconds
5. Replay buffered messages chronologically (FIFO)
6. Publish resume command
7. Report buffer_queue_size: 0

Error handling: catch node logs all errors in format:
[data-buffering] {error_type}: {message}
